candidate.title: The built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Cilium
candidate.text: The built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Cilium. Users of WireGuard transparent encryption are required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support going forward.

evidence.excerpt:
* The built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback (Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`) has been
  deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Cilium. Users of WireGuard transparent
  encryption are required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support going forward.
